title: Country institutions, money and cross-border links
shared: These studies ask how a country’s own institutions, claims and balance sheets connect to money, trade and cross-border relationships. They provide country introductions and narrower tests of a named mechanism.
keep_distinct: Keep each country’s legal forms and jurisdictions intact. IMF classifications, currency windows, market moves, proposals and operating evidence are different measures; a proposed connection remains a hypothesis until its own evidence supports it.
